unresolved_requirements.unknown: Registry inspection or an extracted method cannot establish transport setup, actual callback execution or source identity at runtime.
Do not require downstream completion before the RPC true response; source handler does not wait for it.
Error shape/version and concrete transport receipt must be pinned; missing API execution is unknown.
No unconditional timeout guarantee, event-loop shutdown behavior or infinite status-producer fairness contract is established.
Different subscription objects are distinct request populations; shared channel or equal names alone do not prove object identity.
A closed acknowledgement generated by an arbitrary fake does not prove real map removal.
Observe channel use, not just delivered messages; zero observed messages with incomplete instrumentation is unknown.
The extracted producer is not a real syncing-progress source or RPC notifier.
An infinite competing stream cannot justify deterministic fairness or immediate registration/ack selection.
Only an actual callback/close trace can establish the production overlap; the conditional wait graph alone does not.
No permission to stop pre-existing or external nodes; fixture cancellation is not production loop shutdown support.
A method SHA or candidate name is not an applied commit/tree, actual binary or final agent HEAD receipt.
